title: Geo-ORBIT: A Federated Digital Twin Framework for Scene-Adaptive Lane Geometry Detection
abstract: arXiv:2507.08743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Digital Twins (DT) have the potential to transform traffic management and operations by creating dynamic, virtual representations of transportation systems that sense conditions, analyze operations, and support decision-making. A key component for DT of the transportation system is dynamic roadway geometry sensing. However, existing approaches often rely on static maps or costly sensors, limiting scalability and adaptability. Additionally, large-scale DTs that collect and analyze data from multiple sources face challenges in privacy, communication, and computational efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce Geo-ORBIT (Geometrical Operational Roadway Blueprint with Integrated Twin), a unified framework that combines real-time lane detection, DT synchronization, and federated meta-learning. At the core of Geo-ORBIT is GeoLane, a lightweight lane detection model that learns lane geometries from vehicle trajectory data

translated_title: Geo-ORBIT：一种面向场景自适应车道几何检测的联邦数字孪生框架
translated_abstract: 数字孪生（DT）有潜力通过构建动态的交通系统虚拟表示来变革交通管理与运营，这种虚拟表示能够感知路况、分析运行状态并支持决策。交通系统数字孪生的一个关键组成部分是动态道路几何感知。然而，现有方法通常依赖静态地图或昂贵的传感器，限制了可扩展性和适应性。此外，从多源收集并分析数据的大规模数字孪生在隐私、通信和计算效率方面面临挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Geo-ORBIT（集成孪生的几何运营道路蓝图），这是一个融合了实时车道检测、数字孪生同步和联邦元学习的统一框架。Geo-ORBIT的核心是GeoLane，这是一种轻量级车道检测模型，能够从车辆轨迹数据中学习车道几何形状。
tldr: 该论文提出Geo-ORBIT统一框架，将实时车道检测、数字孪生同步与联邦元学习相结合，利用轻量级GeoLane模型从车辆轨迹数据中学习车道几何，解决了传统静态地图和昂贵传感器方案在可扩展性、适应性、隐私与计算效率方面的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Geo-ORBIT, a unified federated digital twin framework combining real-time lane detection, DT synchronization, and federated meta-learning, whose lightweight GeoLane model learns lane geometries from vehicle trajectory data to overcome the scalability, adaptability, privacy, and computational efficiency limitations of static maps and costly sensors.
